name: amfx-eurusd-close-distribution-research
description: amFX reproduction (20AUG24 p2): Distribution of daily EURUSD closes above 1.08 since Aug 2022. Histogram shows closes binned in 50-pip increments, revealing that closes above 1.1100 are extremely rare (only ~9 in 2 years). The tapering right tail makes the 'rarified air' thesis visually obvious.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: EURUSD CLOSE DISTRIBUTION (20AUG24 p2)
# =============================================================================
# Brent Donnelly's "rarified air" thesis:
# - EURUSD distribution of daily closes above 1.08 since Aug 2022
# - Only ~9 closes above 1.1100 in 2 years
# - Peak frequency around 1.0850 (11 closes)
# - The sparse right tail shows statistical rarity of current levels
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Filter: only keep closes above 1.08, NaN otherwise
filtered_close = close if close > 1.08 else 0.0 / 0.0

histogram(
    title='Distribution of Daily EURUSD Closes >1.08 Since Aug 2022',
    category='EURUSD Distribution',
    x_axis_label='EURUSD Close Price',
    y_axis_label='Count of Daily Closes',
    bin_width=0.005,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.9,
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=4,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.IntegerFormat,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.1100, title='1.1100 Rare Zone', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, vertical=True)
    ]),
    order=0
)(filtered_close)
